purpose: one new tight source for the ANKLE-BOOT cut (shoe cut kit, D-318), drawn at K = 4 for the contract's crop, evaluated unchanged by northstar-shoe-cut-evaluate.mjs; one passed result is evidence for this cut and these cases, not a general validation of all shoes or fault types

call.promptChange: a new prompt for the ankle boot (D-299's sneaker prompt as the pattern): it keeps the reference's geometry and construction and names the four defects of the old source to avoid (stroke tips, skin specks, unclosed rim band, dark tone) and asks for drawn detail

images.name: ankle-boot-layout-image-1.png
images.made: northstar-shoe-cut-reference.mjs: layoutCanvas(guideLayer(the published ankle boot)) — GUIDANCE (geometry, construction, outline style), not finished image quality; the guide drops stroke tips and skin specks in the opening band only

placement.downscale: premultiplied K x K area average

verdict.source: USABLE SOURCE (automatic) when every check rule passes; else REJECTED SOURCE (the failed rules named)
verdict.design: USABLE DESIGN (automatic) when the source is usable, the original colour meets its reproduction and volume rules, and the design passes chainLineCheck; else NOT USABLE
verdict.combination: USABLE COMBINATION (automatic) when its design is usable and R1.checkOutfit passes; else FAIL
verdict.visual: the owner's visual review is recorded BESIDE each automatic class; an automatic FAIL stays FAIL whatever the visual says, and an automatic PASS is usable only with a visual OK
verdict.scope: one passed result is evidence for this cut and these cases, not a general validation of all shoes or fault types

acceptance.afterReceipt: no change to rules, thresholds, contract, master, kit, evaluator or prompt; any change makes the result development material
